_readme: Fixed copy of gemini-code-1789042944332.json. quote-json.html's adapter (amsToEngine in quote-json.html) reads a FLAT ams-service-shaped payload: genInfo, insuredInfo, coveragesInfo, radiusOfOperationsInfo, serviceInspectionInfo, filingInfo, vehicles and drivers all sit directly on the top-level object. The uploaded file had two problems: (1) everything was nested one level deeper, under a `ratingInputs` wrapper the adapter never looks inside, and (2) there was no `genInfo.application_type_id` anywhere -- the very first thing the adapter checks, and the reason the upload failed immediately with 'genInfo.application_type_id is missing -- rating cannot route a submission without it.' This copy un-nests ratingInputs.* back to the top level and adds genInfo.application_type_id: 483 (TRUCK, per APPTYPE_LOB in quote-json.html) -- inferred from the data itself: al_check/pd_check/cargo_check are all true, NAICS 484110 is General Freight Trucking, and the payload carries vehicles and CDL-licensed drivers, which only the Trucking adapter reads. Nothing else in ratingInputs.* was changed.
